rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.002, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-7 REGULARIZATION knob (efficiency pivot). iters 200->400->800->1000 lifted hr 0.1665->0.2178->0.2635->0.2763 monotonically, BUT the data term converged by ~iter 450 (flat 0.740) so all gains are continued TV smoothing, and runtime is now 848s@1000it (wall=1200s) — adding raw iters is nearly exhausted. Reach a smoother optimum PER STEP instead. ONE knob: tv_lambda 0.001->0.002 (2x stronger TV), iterations kept at 1000, gamma=1.0. HYPOTHESIS: stronger TV reaches a more-smoothed optimum in the same 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.2763 at ~same 848s runtime; if it over-smooths (hr drops, fine structure lost) the lambda=1e-3 optimum was near-best and I back toward 1.5e-3. Budget: ~848s, <1200s wall.
